snippet.title: The Radio Tower - Free Horror Game - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4730960/The_Radio_Tower/
Play it Here: https://zagongames.itch.io/the-radio-tower
(Its completely free to play! Just click the "No thanks, just take me to the downloads" button)

You are completele free to repost the trailer anywere you want!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Your name is John and your job is to climb the tallest towers in the world to maintain them, this time you were called urgently to fix the only tower providing cover to the small Crimsonpine city that is currently on quarantine for unknown reasons.

Climb the radio tower at the edge of an evacuation zone and fix it to restore the communications.

Content:
- 10 to 15 minutes of gameplay.
- 3 different achievements.
- A weird story
- A chase scene

The Radio Tower - Free Horror Game - Trailer
